design_decisions: Liveness events live in table as_liveness_events created idempotently (no migration number, no user_version bump): OPERATIONAL_SCHEMA_VERSION is 4 and assertOperationalSchemaBoundary rejects higher versions; as_events has a closed kind CHECK.
Extra event kind heartbeat (not in the spec list) is needed as the only activity signal that is not turn_end; recorded by report --event heartbeat, by await ticks and by watch reconciliation.
report accepts --event turn_end|heartbeat plus --pid/--status-file/--worktree (source of truth); the fixed LV1 interface report --json <line> is unchanged.
DONE requires evidence; WAITING_ON deadline must be future and within stall_timeout_s.
wake_via human escalates on overdue without wake attempts.
not_verified: systemd units were rendered and escaped-tested, never installed or run under systemd
notify-send delivery not exercised (notifier injected in tests)
no run against a live Claude Code or Codex session; LV1 hook integration not exercised
full test:kernel, full npm test and the pre-commit gate are not part of this receipt
job status reconciliation covers as_agent_runs/as_runs only: the W4 job ledger (execution_events) is pending activation in the operational DB, so job state is not consulted
tokens per run (not implemented: SubagentStop payload has no tokens)
wake_via human/commander WAITING_ON with long deadlines was exercised only in the ledger and unit tests, not in a real session
pending-reports drain against a live guard invocation in a real Claude Code or Codex session
